spm152.nii.gz.desc: T1-weighted MNI152 template brain (SPM average size), 2 mm; good background for MNI-space statistics
spm152.nii.gz.license: ICBM 2009 nonlinear template (MNI; free use with attribution)

spmMotor.nii.gz.desc: fMRI motor task t-statistic map in MNI space (positive and negative values); overlay on spm152

mni152.nii.gz.desc: T1-weighted MNI152 2009 template brain (0.74 mm); opened at startup. Slightly larger brain than spm152
mni152.nii.gz.license: ICBM 2009 nonlinear template (MNI; free use with attribution)

chris_t1.nii.gz.desc: T1-weighted MRI of one individual (native space)

chris_t2.nii.gz.desc: T2-weighted MRI of one individual (native space)

chris_MRA.nii.gz.desc: MR angiogram (bright vessels); ideal for maximum intensity projection

CT_Abdo.nii.gz.desc: Abdominal CT in Hounsfield units; use ct_* colormaps
CT_Abdo.nii.gz.license: Slicer example dataset (S. Pieper); not stated

CT_Philips.nii.gz.desc: Head CT in Hounsfield units; use ct_* colormaps

motor_4t95vol.nii.gz.desc: fMRI motor t-statistic volume in MNI space (FWE threshold ~4.95); paint onto meshes with addMeshLayer

BrainMesh_ICBM152.lh.mz3.desc: Left hemisphere cortical surface mesh (MNI space)
BrainMesh_ICBM152.lh.mz3.license: BrainNet Viewer (Xia et al. 2013); not stated

BrainMesh_ICBM152.rh.mz3.desc: Right hemisphere cortical surface mesh (MNI space)
BrainMesh_ICBM152.rh.mz3.license: BrainNet Viewer (Xia et al. 2013); not stated

BrainMesh_ICBM152_smoothed.lh.mz3.desc: Smoothed left hemisphere surface (shows deep structures through it)
BrainMesh_ICBM152_smoothed.lh.mz3.license: BrainNet Viewer (Xia et al. 2013); not stated

mni152_2009.mz3.desc: Whole-brain surface mesh of the MNI152 2009 template
mni152_2009.mz3.license: ICBM 2009 nonlinear template (MNI; free use with attribution)

scalp.mz3.desc: Scalp surface mesh (MNI space); use with low opacity around a brain

motor_4t95mesh.mz3.desc: Isosurface mesh of the motor fMRI activation (MNI space)

CIT168.mz3.desc: Subcortical nuclei atlas as meshes (Pauli et al. 2018)

aal.json.desc: Region names and colors for aal.nii.gz: nv.setColormapLabelFromUrl(volumeIndex, 'aal.json')
aal.json.license: BSD-2-Clause (NiiVue dev-images); AAL, Tzourio-Mazoyer et al. 2002

aal.nii.gz.desc: AAL anatomical atlas: labeled regions in MNI space

yeh2022.trx.desc: HCP-1065 tractography atlas (Yeh 2022) in MNI space; streamlines grouped into named bundles: nv.getTractGroups(0), setTractOptions(0, { groupColors })

TR_S_R.tt.gz.desc: Superior thalamic radiation, right (one bundle of the HCP-1065 tractography atlas, MNI space; DSI Studio .tt format)

LPBA40.jcon.desc: Connectome: nodes and edges for the 56 LPBA40 regions (MNI space)
LPBA40.jcon.license: BSD-2-Clause (MRIcroGL, github.com/rordenlab/MRIcroGL); LPBA40 atlas, Shattuck et al. 2008
